items.question: What does the colophon declare about the completion of the ninth kautuka treasury in the Śrītattvanidhi?
premises: It states the ninth kautuka nidhi is completed.
items.inference: The ninth kautuka treasury of the Śrītattvanidhi is declared complete.
uncertainties: The supplied line is treated as one token despite internal spaces.
Sandhi and word boundaries are not separately resolved.
items.plain_english: Thus, in the text called Śrītattvanidhi, the ninth kautuka treasury is completed.
